Treatment summary
Treatment summary, provider perspective. The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection and reports
neck pain consistent with whiplash. The mechanism and force of the collision are reasonably consistent with the reported injury.
Over the course of care, the paitent has attended 34 visits, with near-daily attendance for much of that period. Additional body
regions were added to the complaint several weeks after the collision. Nearly all findings documented to date rest on the patient's
self-reported pain levels and symptom descriptions. Cervical and related imaging were unremarkable, and the physical
examination tests performed were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same region is known from the patient's history.
Two charges of similar type on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. Ongoing care and the final plan will be
revisited once the review is complete.
